from java.lang import Exception as JavaException
	from washheat import catalog
	try:
	    self.view.custom.parts = catalog.list_parts(self.view.custom.search)
	    self.view.custom.message = "Part data refreshed (up to 500 matches). Click a row to edit."
	except (Exception, JavaException) as error:
	    self.view.custom.parts = []
	    self.view.custom.message = "DATABASE UNAVAILABLE: " + str(error)

from java.lang import Exception as JavaException
	from washheat import catalog
	# Event values contain displayed columns; row indexes can age during refresh.
	# Resolve all five displayed immutable keys to the current complete SQL record.
	row = catalog.resolve(event.value, active_only=False)
	self.view.custom.form = dict((key, row[key]) for key in catalog.FIELDS)
	self.view.custom.recipeId = row["recipe_id"]
	self.view.custom.revision = row["revision"]
	self.view.custom.message = "Editing " + row["part_number"] + " / " + row["press_recipe"] + " / revision " + str(row["revision"])
	self.view.custom.history = []

from java.lang import Exception as JavaException
	from washheat import catalog
	try:
	    parsed = catalog.parse_barcode(self.view.custom.barcode)
	    form = {'part_number': '', 'stage': '', 'qa_spec': '', 'press_recipe': '', 'press_qa': '', 'od_in': '', 'height_in': '', 'circle_in': '', 'max_transfer_seconds': '', 'dh_cycle_start_seconds': '', 'dh_tonnage_seconds': '', 'notes': '', 'active': True}
	    form.update(catalog.key(parsed))
	    self.view.custom.form = form
	    self.view.custom.recipeId = ""
	    self.view.custom.revision = 0
	    self.view.custom.history = []
	    self.view.custom.message = "Decoded " + parsed["serial_number"] + ". Enter measured dimensions; the ticket supplies none."
	except (Exception, JavaException) as error:
	    self.view.custom.message = "SCAN NOT LOADED: " + str(error)

config.script:
from java.lang import Exception as JavaException
	from washheat import catalog
	record = None
	try:
	    if not self.session.props.auth.authenticated:
	        raise ValueError("Sign in to save part data.")
	    record = catalog.save(dict(self.view.custom.form), self.session.props.auth.user.userName, self.view.custom.recipeId or None, self.view.custom.revision)
	    self.view.custom.recipeId = record["recipe_id"]
	    self.view.custom.revision = record["revision"]
	    self.view.custom.form = dict((key,record[key]) for key in catalog.FIELDS)
	    self.view.custom.message = "Saved revision " + str(record["revision"]) + ". Existing runs retain their original dimensions."
	    self.view.custom.parts = catalog.list_parts(self.view.custom.search)
	except (Exception, JavaException) as error:
	    if record is None:
	        self.view.custom.message = "NOT SAVED: " + str(error)
	    else:
	        self.view.custom.message = "SAVED revision " + str(record["revision"]) + "; table refresh failed: " + str(error)
